title: Living reptilians from a crash were shot

tellings.quote: >> Do you know what supposedly happened to those living reptilians from the crash? >> Uh uh deceased. They were killed.

plain: Reptile-like beings are said to have come out of a crashed craft alive and then been killed. In a clip played on the show, a speaker who is not identified is asked what happened to "those living reptilians from the crash" and answers, "deceased. They were killed," passing on what someone else had told them. If true, it would mean living beings were recovered from a crash and then deliberately killed.
